Every body meets the ground. Nobody disrupted how.

We start at the feet: urgent, reimbursable, life changing. Our first product redistributes pressure passively, before damage begins. It fits a standard running shoe.

Why feet first ↘
Every 20 seconds, a limb is lost.

Pressure failure starts at the foot: tissue breakdown, ulceration, amputation. For people living with diabetes, comfort is prevention.

The product

Every step, perfectly redistributed.

01

Pressure, redistributed

Load on one compliant unit stiffens its neighbors, spreading force across a larger area. At the foot, the hand, the joint.

02

Nothing to fail

No actuators, no electronics required. Over 1.17 million compression cycles with no loss of function. And when data is wanted, the same architecture integrates sensing.

03

Energy, returned

Shape morphing structures store and release energy with every step. Human gait and robotic locomotion alike.

The formula
Intelligence in geometry.

Hundreds of compliant hexagons, each adapting independently under load. All passive. No power, no software. The behavior lives in the shape itself.
